newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends $5 up, sets sight on $200.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends $5 up, sets sight on $200.

text.p: IPE Sept gas oil futures ended $5 higher on Thursday with many traders predicting the contract could soon hit the $200 per tonne mark.
"These levels look very firm. As far as I can see the only way is up," one trader.
The Sept gas oil contract settled at $196.75 after hitting a contract high of $198.50 during the day, the strongest level since it hit $200 on April 9.
Traders attributed gas oil's recent strength mainly to low stocks in the U.S. and Europe.
U.S. heating oil and diesel inventories are roughly 15 percent lower than a year ago. European gas oil stocks are below normal for the time of the year.
Traders also noted that a major player was seen buying heavily, although it was not clear whether this was to cover short positions or take a fresh long position.
"The shorts are starting to panic," one trader said.
Others said the player was simply testing out the levels of the September contract.
Oct Brent was up 48 cents at $20.75 a barrel at 1703 GMT.
